item.title: Linden businesses urged to tap US trade, investment opportunities
item.description: Businesses in Linden are being encouraged to explore global opportunities through trade partnerships, investment programmes and industry conferences, as part of efforts to strengthen links between Guyanese enterprises and the United States (US) market. item.title: Racer who slapped rival after track accident faces ban
item.description: The Guyana Motor Racing and Sports Club (GMR&SC) has strongly condemned a slapping incident during the final of the Supermoto race at its sanctioned ‘Kart Revival’ event on Sunday, warning that penalties and bans will be enforced.

item.title: Pitamber crowned national open chess champion; Joshi retains women’s title
item.description: Candidate Master Sachin Pitamber is the 2026 National Chess Champion, while Woman Candidate Master Aditi Joshi has successfully retained her title as Women’s Chess Champion for 2026.

item.title: Karting incident: Vieira apologises for slapping Singh
item.description: Matthew Vieira has issued a public apology and accepted full responsibility after slapping fellow racer Ravi Singh during an incident at the GMR&SC karting competition.

item.title: Expansion in Guyana drives ANSA McAL’s strong year-end performance
item.description: ANSA McAL’s operations in Guyana have emerged as a key driver of the conglomerate’s growth, contributing just over 12 per cent of group revenue in 2025—making it the company’s second-largest market.

item.title: Guyana shines at CARIFTA vs The Rest meet
item.description: Guyana’s junior team showcased impressive talent during the recent “CARIFTA vs The Rest” meet at the National Track and Field Centre, West Coast Demerara.

item.title: Caribbean has lost a ‘fine statesman’, says president
item.description: The death of former Suriname President Chandrikapersad Santokhi marks the loss of a “fine statesman” for the Caribbean, Guyana’s President Irfaan Ali said on Monday.

item.title: Calls amplified for more women to join Guyana’s aviation sector
item.description: Calls have amplified for more women to join Guyana’s aviation sector, as the Guyana Civil Aviation Authority (GCAA) launched its first Women in Aviation Conference on Monday.

item.title: US ambassador: Hard, unequivocal evidence exists against the Mohameds, confident of conviction
item.description: The United States has “hard evidence” against indicted Guyanese businessmen Nazar and Azruddin Mohamed and is confident of a conviction if they are extradited to face charges in America, U.S. Ambassador Nicole Theriot said.

item.title: US Ambassador praises government, says oil funds being used for citizen development
item.description: US Ambassador Nicole Theriot praises Irfaan Ali for promoting effective oil governance and citizen development in Guyana.
